gather_sources_and_dependencies: gather all source files and package dependencies from a Python experiment's globals dict
Source_create: create a Source object with file digest and optional git commit info for a given filename
PackageDependency_create: create a PackageDependency object from an imported Python module to capture its name and version
get_digest: compute the MD5 hash digest of a file for change detection and reproducibility tracking
is_local_source: check if a module file belongs to the local experiment directory or is an external package dependency
